Name: Uriel, Chief of Kohath
Summary: Chief of the sons of Kohath who brought up the ark, with his brethren an hundred and twenty.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:5; 1 Chronicles 15:11: Chief of the sons of Kohath who brought up the ark, with his brethren an hundred and twenty.
LifeLesson: The mention of Uriel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
